findings.message: Restore copying corev1.LabelTopologyZone. Removing this call violates the supplied retention contract: an existing node's nonempty topology.kubernetes.io/zone label is omitted from the template when other label sources do not provide it. Retaining the legacy zone label does not preserve the stable label.
findings.evidence: CHANGE.diff removes the LabelTopologyZone copy. extractNodeLabels constructs a fresh map containing only explicitly selected keys (lines 641–659), and setLabelIfNotEmpty copies only its requested key (662–665). buildTemplateLabels merges this extracted map from an existing node at line 462; TemplateNodeInfo assigns the result to node.Labels at line 418. Generic labels contain no zone (628–637). Resource-provided labels may supply the stable key, but do not cover the case where it exists only on the existing node.

result.coverage: Reviewed TASK.json, CHANGE.diff, the changed extraction helper, and its template-building caller flow. Identified one distinct contract violation and checked alternative label sources.
limitations: Only the supplied production source was inspected; external dependency implementations and scheduler consumers are unavailable.
No tests were run. Specific downstream scheduling or scale-up failures were not established.
result.contribution: Established the local path from existing-node label extraction to template node labels, and narrowed the impact to cases where another label source does not supply the stable zone key.
